## A Practical Assessment for K-12 Leaders


Over the past five years, there have been more than[1,500 incidents](https://k12ssdb.org/all-shootings) of gun violence on school grounds, including cases where a firearm was discharged, brandished with intent to harm, or a bullet struck school property. Research also shows that many school shootings begin as the escalation of a dispute rather than a pre-planned attack.


Schools work diligently to reduce risk, prevent weapons from entering campus, and create an environment where students can focus on learning.


Whether you’re refining an existing[security screening](https://evolv.com/concealed-weapons-detection/) approach or launching something new, readiness comes down to one question:


#### If tomorrow were day one, would your plan actually work?


- Would students know where to go?
- Would staff know what to do when something happens?
- Would arrival feel smooth, or backed up?
- Would families understand what’s changing?


This playbook is designed to help you assess where you stand, and what to do next.
